name: RC-B10-0146/2025/REV1 – After § 58 – Am 65
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the white paper on the future of European defence
part_text: 58c. Calls on the Member States to withdraw US military bases from their territories and to strengthen Europe’s strategic autonomy without being influenced by external interests; considers that the presence of foreign troops on European soil undermines the sovereignty and independence of Member States’ foreign and defence policies;
